direction: hand-assembled felt, fabric, buttons, and cardboard

type.note: System fonts only; no proprietary game font is bundled.

materials.felt: Use the generated plate as a tactile crop; keep large surfaces matte and low contrast.
materials.thread: Use dashed seams only where a piece joins another piece.
materials.wood: Warm disk, visible rim, holes, and a short contact shadow.
materials.cardboard: Layered brown edge, exposed corrugation, tabs, and folded planes.

motion.selection: Short lift or scale change with a static outline state.
